datasets.description: Database developed end of December 2017 for a purpose of Gure Shembola Refugee Camp Water Supply Coverage Analysis in January 2018. lineage.description: Direct observational field survey data collected end of December 2017 documenting water supply infrastructure (reservoirs, water points, taps, distribution systems) and camp spatial units (blocks, zones) in Gure Shembola Refugee Camp. Data was compiled into geospatial vector datasets (shapefiles) to support water supply coverage analysis and service delivery planning.
